name: principia
description: The launchpad your repositories write for themselves. Ships empty, fills up as each repo describes its flows, agents and work.

commands.title: Principia: Set up this repo with an agent

principia.openOnStartup.description: When to open the launchpad automatically.

principia.refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between background refreshes. Only ticks while the tab is focused. 0 disables polling.

principia.maxRepos.description: How many recently-opened repositories to track.

principia.specPath.description: Absolute path to a local checkout of the Principia repo, used so agents can read the contract and the validator. Leave empty to use the copy bundled with the extension.
